metadata.title: [EPIC][UI][OBSERVABILITY]: Admin Overview redesign with actionable topology and health signals
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
> **Note:** This PR was re-created from #3032 due to repository maintenance. Your code and branch are intact. @crivetimihai please verify everything looks good.

## Summary
- redesign the Admin Overview with actionable topology cards driven by aggregated health signals
- preserve the classic topology map for architecture-at-a-glance context
- add robust overview drilldown routing into Observability (URL state + post-settle application)
- fix early page-init failure in `admin.js` caused by binding to `document.body` before it exists
- gate LLM Settings UI rendering by `llmchat_enabled` to avoid `/admin/llm/*` partial 404s when disabled
- expand JS/unit coverage for overview drilldown, health refresh behavior, helper metrics, and feature-flag context
- make the Playwright autocomplete test resilient when LLM Settings is intentionally unavailable

Closes #2991

commits.message:
feat(ui): redesign admin overview with actionable topology

- add topology payload, health signal classification, and stale/fresh context

- add actionable drilldowns from overview into observability filters

- restore classic topology map while retaining actionable topology cards

- prevent early overview JS init failure and gate LLM settings UI by llmchat flag

- expand JS/unit/playwright coverage for overview and LLM tab behavior

Closes #2991

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
